name: White Bean-Cauliflower Soup with Tomato, Fresh Basil & Garlic Sticks

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions; peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, garlic, and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, separate each cauliflower head into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add cauliflower and water to the pot with the onion; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, while preparing the tomatoes.

Halve tomatoes; add to the pot along with the beans and broth. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the garlic oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place flatbread on a large baking sheet pan and spread garlic oil over top; place in the oven and broil until golden and crisp, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven and slice crosswise into sticks.
While the garlic bread is toasting, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the soup is done, add vinegar, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
Divide soup between bowls and top with basil. Serve with breadsticks on the side and enjoy!
